title: Endbot operation registry
description: operations.json: every operation, the shapes of its typed parameters and their command clauses, and the reserved Bot names. Python (operations.py), the Luau bootstrap (runner/api.luau) and the operator reference read it; later the web Worker generates its types from it.

additionalProperties.description: The shapes an operation accepts, tried in order; the first that fits the parameters wins.

reservedBotNames.description: Names no Bot may be created or renamed to, because a root command word takes them (interface guide D3). Compared without case.

name.description: A parameter name, spelled the same in commands, Luau and the web.

type.description: The value's type; coordinate also takes ~ relative forms, the two unions take either kind.

clause.description: The command word written before the value.

options.description: Optional fields, in command order after the positional ones.

prefix.description: Literal words between the operation and its first field.
